# NearPro — llms.txt
# https://nearpro.s8n.in
# India's First Trusted B2B Lead Intelligence Platform & Autonomous Agency Operating System

## About
NearPro is a B2B lead intelligence platform and autonomous agency operating system built for Indian freelancers, digital marketing agencies, web developers, and sales professionals. It provides verified local business data, AI-powered cold outreach generation, website auditing, PDF proposal drafting, tele-sales script creation, and 360-degree deal tracking — all in a single unified workstation.

## Key Capabilities
- Verified Local Business Directory: 12,358+ cross-verified Mumbai business profiles across 10+ categories (Healthcare, Real Estate, Beauty & Wellness, Technology, Food & Dining, Finance & Legal, Education, and more). Filter by area (Bandra, Andheri, Powai, etc.), rating, phone availability, email, and website presence.
- 1-Click Business Health Check: Real-time website audit scoring PageSpeed performance, mobile responsiveness, SEO meta tags, SSL security, and conversion readiness.
- AI Multi-Channel Outreach Studio: Generate personalized cold outreach messages in Hinglish or English for WhatsApp or Email. Messages are tailored to the lead's actual rating, location, website status, and business gaps.
- 3-Page PDF Proposal Generator: Draft custom agency proposals with pricing tiers, scope of work, and deliverables. Export to PDF or share via public link.
- Tele-Sales Teleprompter Scripts: Generate cold call scripts with opening hooks, gatekeeper bypass strategies, value propositions, objection handling, and closing CTAs.
- 360° AI Deal Workstation (CRM): Track leads through pipeline stages — New Lead, Contacted, In Progress, Closed Won, Closed Lost — with follow-up reminders, deal values, and conversion tracking.
- Smart Lists & Lead Management: Create custom tagged lead lists, batch export to CSV, and organize prospects by category or campaign.
- Connection Hub: Zoho CRM integration via bi-directional sync, webhook automation, and API key management.
- Team Workspace: Multi-seat collaboration with shared lead pools and data request management.
- Documents Library: Document repository with shareable public links for proposals and reports.

## Pricing (Indian Rupees)
- Explorer (Free Forever): Browse directory, test AI tools, 2-minute anonymous preview session.
- Scout (₹499/month or ₹4,999/year): Unlock all contact details, 10 website audits/month, 10 AI outreach generations/month, Zoho CRM integration.
- Hunter (₹999/month or ₹9,999/year): Unlimited AI outreach, bulk operations, conversion scoring, whitelabel reports.
- Agency (₹2,499/month or ₹24,999/year): Team workspace, unlimited CSV exports, priority support, data requests.

## Technology
- Frontend: Vite + Vanilla JavaScript SPA with Leaflet.js map clustering
- Backend: Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security, Edge Functions (Deno/TypeScript)
- AI: Google Gemini API for outreach generation, call scripts, and proposals
- Payments: Razorpay (Indian payment gateway) with subscription management
- Data Pipeline: Python + Playwright scraper → DuckDB → Supabase sync with category mapping and geographic area extraction

## Target Users
- Freelance web developers seeking local clients
- Digital marketing agency owners doing outbound prospecting
- B2B sales representatives targeting local businesses
- Local business consultants and service providers
- Real estate agents, healthcare marketers, and professional service providers

## Geographic Coverage
Currently live: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (12,358+ verified businesses)
Expanding to: Pune, Delhi, Bangalore
